fields.backstory:
A cheerful, earnest and family-loving boy who lives in the tranquil Ribeira Village. He was living peacefully with his childhood friends, but on his 15th birthday, the cogs of fate began to turn.

Likes: Moving around, catching animals

An elegant swordsman who’s always seeking to fight powerful opponents to satisfy his thirst. A foreigner who travelled across the seas from the land of “Fódlan”.

Likes: Things he finds “beautiful”, sweets, his little sister

The young queen of the Kingdom of Saramis, which serves the Dagdan Empire. Possesses an unwavering resolve to face any obstacle and has the qualities of a queen who guides her people.

Likes: Fighting, the well-being of her people

A highly skilled vihuela player who performs enchanting music. Following a “certain incident” 5 years ago, she started walking a path of vengeance and hatred.

Likes: Memories of her parents, performing music from her homeland, jewels, applause

Cai’s childhood friend. An avid reader, who has a wide range of knowledge despite being only 15 years old. She lives with her grandfather, who’s a former tactician, and as his granddaughter, she’s inherited his keen talent for strategy.

Likes: Libraries, discussing love, grandfather, board games

An enigmatic missionary of the Church of Seiros, from the distant land of Fódlan. While rational, he often looks down on others, calling them “beasts”. He and Dietrich share the same hometown, but didn’t know each other.

Likes: Various types of pain, talking to intelligent people

Theodora’s right hand man; a wise general from the Kingdom of Saramis who continues to serve on the front-lines. In a kingdom where writing is forbidden, he records all of Saramis’s history and wisdom in his memory.

Likes: Memorising knowledge, philosophical debates, reciting poetry

A veteran warrior nicknamed the “Demon Bear”. He served Leda’s father for many years and sometimes calls Leda “m’lady” out of habit. He follows Leda on her quest for revenge, but has complicated feelings about it.

Likes: Loyalty, mentoring promising young people, imagining Leda’s happiness

A 15 year old boy who grew up with Cai like brothers. Has amazing eyesight, enough to see the stars during the day. His archery skills are outstanding, but his kind and timid nature holds back his full potential.

Likes: Mother’s cooking, Ginji fruit, cloud watching

A fisherman’s daughter, from a fishing village on the Dagdan coast. Wild at heart, with superhuman strength despite her build. She joined Dietrich after he rescued her from being sacrificed to a sea beast.

Likes: Handsome men, harpooning, fishing gear maintenance

A tough general of Saramis, known for his strength and defences; he refers to Queen Theodora as “young lady”.
Like Bonaparte, he served the kingdom since the previous king and has achieved many military feats on the battlefield.
Bad at thinking and remembering names.

Likes: alcohol, fighting, singing, socialising

A mysterious bard who appears during Leda’s path of vengeance. Calls himself the “Whimsical Wind”. He’s flirtatious, hitting on every beautiful woman he sees, but also has keen perception and is well-educated.

Likes: Goddess Karla, all women, poetry

A young priestess serving at the Aurora Temple at the upper levels of Dagsion. Kind and caring, she watches over Cai–who’s competing in the gruelling Heroic Games with his childhood friends–like a younger brother, always ready to help him out.

Likes: Taking care of others, family, all types of housework, romance stories

An ex-mercenary who came to Dagsion to fund her only daughter’s education. She was once a formidable warrior known as “Mikaela the Ironblood”, her name even reaching Buccar, the “Demon Bear of Baphos”.

Likes: Taking care of others, brewing tasty coffee

A genius Saraminian knight. Hails from a renowned family; his uncle serves as chancellor, and his father is a great warrior whose name is etched in the kingdom’s history. He’s loyal and capable, but his desire to succeed without relying on his family can cause him to act rashly.

Likes: Gazing at the sky

A young Saraminian archer. Values money above all else and often lacks manners, even towards her liege, Theodora. Yet her archery skill is undeniable. Her background is slightly complicated; she hails from a renowned family, but her father lost his title after the civil war.

Likes: Gold coins, jewels, older men
